current.summary: The main bedroom. A black four-poster frame bed with a sage headboard cushion, an arched window-pane mirror above it, cage wall lights either side, a wooden-blade ceiling fan and a disco ball. At the foot of the bed a dark green velvet sofa; opposite, a TV on a dark chest of drawers with brass handles; a walnut wardrobe; an antique inlaid cabinet with an ornate gilt mirror and Sicilian teste di moro. Brass chandelier with globe bulbs. The room has its original features: an ornate plaster cornice all round, old panelled doors and built-in cupboard doors, a black-painted skirting band, and a beautiful patterned cement-tile floor (star and lattice design with a border, plainer dark tiles round the edge). Walls are cream and marked by the recent works: pencilled “TUBI DA 25” pipe notes, patches, a white access cover, and a broken section of cornice at one corner with an open hole. A cord and a cable are strung across the ceiling; one door is covered in filler patches awaiting paint. The French window opens onto the front balcony.
